environment.description: Spring Boot application deployed on AWS Lambda via AWS Lambda Web Adapter (LWA), exposed through a Lambda Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL is publicly accessible without any authentication requirement. The Lambda execution role has broad permissions including network access. Commons-collections 3.2.1 is on the classpath via a transitive dependency from the legacy ETL shared library.

config.deployment: AWS Lambda with Lambda Web Adapter
config.network: Lambda has outbound internet access via NAT gateway
config.resource_policy: allows principal '*' to invoke function URL
